acceptance: A reproducible table (bundle short id, run timestamp, worktree commit at run time, wheel version, evidence source) for all 58 bundles is written to CORPUS_NOTES, replacing the contradictory sentences; the command(s) used to build it are recorded.
Each wheel value is backed by primary evidence (vendored pin at the commit, venv _vendor archive, or run log line); bundles without evidence are listed as unknown with the reason.
The 'recorded by the repository lock' sentence is replaced by 'the vendored pin benchbox/_vendor/sqlglot.json', so the notes give one consistent account.
PR merged via make pr-open (oracle SHIP, no override) and make pr-arm; `uv run -- python results-data/validate_corpus.py` exits 0.
context: DECISION GATE: if more than a handful of bundles have no primary evidence, STOP and ask the owner whether to attest only the evidenced ones or none.
description:
results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md contradicts itself about the translator used by the 58 local rerun bundles ingested by PR #3678: one passage (~line 910) says all 58 ran on wheel 30.24.0.17; another (~lines 994-995) says 14 ran on 30.25.0.2; another (~line 1259) says the wheel 'is recorded by the repository lock, not by the bundles', which is false (uv.lock has no sqlglot entry; the vendored wheel has no dist-info). Before any sidecar attests a translator version, establish per bundle which wheel actually ran, from primary evidence.

VALID EVIDENCE (strongest first): benchbox/_vendor/sqlglot.json (or the archive filename) at the exact worktree commit each run used (match bundle run timestamps against the history of chore/superseded-reruns-bundles and the adoption PRs #3587 (30.25.0.1) and #3649 (30.25.0.2)); the `benchbox/_vendor` contents of the venv used (e.g. /tmp/bbvenv-linux-sgrr for the container lane) if still present; run log lines naming the wheel. Missing evidence: record 'unknown' with the reason, never guess.

GUARDRAILS: bundle JSON never modified; only CORPUS_NOTES text; every per-bundle wheel claim cites its evidence; no new runs.
